Tractor Sazi - Shabab Al Ahli Jonli Translyatsiya — Onlayn Beparvo Tomosha Qiling | 14 aprel 2026

O'yin boshlanishi: 14 aprel 2026, 14:45 UTC (18:15 Tehron / 18:45 Dubay)

Stadion: Amir Abdullah Al Faisal Sport Shahri Stadion, Jidda

Musobaqa: AFC Chempionlar Ligasi Elite 2025/26

Bosqich: G'arb Guruh - O'chirish O'yinlari

O'yin Oldidan

Tractor Sazi va Shabab Al Ahli AFC Chempionlar Ligasi Elite 2025/26 da uchrashadi, bu avvalgi uchrashuvdir - bu ikki jamoa ushbu mintaqaviy bahsda ikki marta to'qnash kelgan. Tractor O'zbekiston Guruhiga kuchli muvaffaqiyat bilan kiradi, 11 ball bilan 3-o'rinda (5 o'yinda 3 g'alaba, 2 durang va 0 mag'lubiyat, 8 gol urilgan, faqat 1 gol o'tkazilgan) - bu mavsum uchun ularning mintaqaviy imkoniyatlarini ta'kidlaydigan ajoyib himoya rekordidir. Shabab Al Ahli 4-o'rinda 10 ball (3 g'alaba, 1 durang, 1 mag'lubiyat, 12 gol urilgan, 6 gol o'tkazilgan) joylashib, bu hal qiluvchi uchrashuvga kirarkanda Tractor’dan bitta ball ajratilgan.

Tavakkal qilib bo'lmaydi: birinchi bo'lib g'alaba qozonadigan jamoa o'chirish muzokaralarida kuchliroq pozitsiyani qo'lga kiritadi. Tractor'ın ajralmas gol farqi (+7) Shabab'ning +6 ga nisbatan, natija va g'alaba margini real narxga ega bo'lishini anglatadi. Durang Shabab'ni talabning ichida saqlaydi, lekin Tractor'ga psixologik ustunlikni beradi - agar BAA jamoasi Eronliklardan yuqorida tugatishni istasa, g'alaba qozonish yakkama-yakka qabul qilinadi.

Hisob-kitob (H2H)

Bu ikki jamoa 3 marta to'qnash kelgan, rekord mutlaqo muvozanatlangan: 1 g'alaba har biri va 1 durang. Uchinchi uchrashuvning barchasi AFC Chempionlar Ligasi doirasida bo'lib o'tgan. Muhim tomoni, 2026-yil 2-martda ularning eng so'nggi to'qnashuvi - ushbu turnirdan oldin - 0–0 yakunlandi, har ikki himoya ustunlik ko'rsatdi. O'shandan avval, 2025-yil sentyabr oyida o'tkazilgan guruh bosqichidagi uchrashuv 1–1 (Štrkalj 14' Tractor uchun, Guilherme Bala 65' Shabab uchun) natija bilan tugagan. Yanada orqaga qaytib, Tractor 2015-yilda Shababni 3–2 hisobida yutgan. Barchasi uchun jamoalarning uchrashuvidagi gol soni: 4–4.

Tractor G'arb Guruhida eng himoyaviy jihatdan mustahkam jamoa -5 o'yinda 1 gol o'tkazish mintaqaviy darajada ajoyib rekorddir. Bayonot qilinmasdan (3 g'alaba, 2 durang) turnirda yutmagan va natijalarning mahkamligini ko'rsatishi bilan haqiqiylikni quyida davom ettirgan. 2025-yil sentyabrda o'tkazilgan uchrashuvda Tomislav Štrkalj asosiy hujumkor tahdid bo'lib, gol urdi. Ularning ichki mavzusi ham Eron ligasida kuchli formaga ega jamoani tasdiqlaydi - Tractor 2025/26 yilgi Pars Zaxira Pro Ligasi 2-o'rinda, 3 o'yinda 10 ball bilan joylashgan.

Shabab Al Ahli guruhdagi raqobatchilar orasida eng ko'p gol uruvchi - 5 o'yinda 12 gol bilan - har o'yinda 2.4 gol urish o'rtacha. Guilherme Bala ularning ajralmas futbolchisi bo'lib, Tractor bilan sentyabrdagi to'qnashuvda tenglashtiruvchi gol urdi. Biroq, Tractor himoyasini (bu mavsumdagi 180 daqiqa davomida 0 gol) yorib o'ta olishmayapti, bu katta muammo. Ularning mehmon o'yinlarida 1.75 gol o'rtacha, ammo Tractor himoyasi oldida hammasi kerak bo'ladi.

Kick-off: 14 April 2026, 15:15 UTC (18:15 Moscow / 20:15 Tashkent)

Stadium: Milliy Stadium, Tashkent, Uzbekistan

Competition: Uzbekistan Super League 2026

Matchday: Round 7

Match Preview

This is the standout fixture of Matchday 7 in the Uzbekistan Super League 2026 — a top-of-the-table clash between two of the country's most storied clubs. Neftchi Fargona lead the Super League in 1st place with 15 points from 6 matches (5W–0D–1L), boasting a jaw-dropping goal difference of +14 (16 scored, just 2 conceded). Bunyodkor sit 4th with 13 points from 6 matches (4W–1D–1L, GD +4) — separated from the leaders by 2 points. A Bunyodkor win closes the gap completely; a Neftchi win extends their lead to 5 points and effectively ends the title race early.

Neftchi arrive in Tashkent on a form streak that borders on dominant: their last five Super League results read W–W–W–W–W, including a 4–0 demolition of Qizilqum (4 April) and a 3–1 win over Lokomotiv Tashkent (20 March). Bunyodkor, meanwhile, are quietly building — their last result was a 1–0 away win at Mash'al (7 April, Rashid Abubakar 33'), showing they can grind out results away from home. Playing at Milliy Stadium, Bunyodkor will lean heavily on home advantage against a side that has historically been vulnerable on the road against top opposition.

Head-to-Head (H2H)

Across 33 all-time meetings, Bunyodkor hold a clear historical dominance: 19 wins to Neftchi's 8, with 6 draws. The overall goal tally reads 47–26 in Bunyodkor's favour. However, recent years have seen the tide shift. In the last 5 meetings, the record is level — 2 wins each and 1 draw — suggesting Neftchi have evolved significantly as a rival. The most recent clash on 8 March 2025 ended 2–2 at Milliy Stadium, while before that Neftchi won 1–2 away in Tashkent (2 August 2025). Recent H2H goals average 3.4 per game — an entertaining head-to-head.

events.title: Al Ittihad - Al Wahda
events.dataContent:
Al Ittihad vs Al Wahda Live Stream — Watch Online Free | 14 April 2026

Kick-off: 14 April 2026, 18:00 UTC (21:00 Moscow / 22:00 Jeddah)

Stadium: Alinma Stadium, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

Competition: AFC Champions League Elite 2025/26

Stage: Round of 16

Match Preview

Al Ittihad host Al Wahda FC (UAE) at the Alinma Stadium in Jeddah in the AFC Champions League Elite Round of 16 — the most high-profile knockout tie of the West bracket. This match was originally scheduled for 10 March 2026 but was postponed and is now being played on 14 April. The delay has only amplified anticipation for a contest that pits Saudi Arabia's most decorated club against one of the UAE's strongest continental performers this season.

Al Ittihad enter the tie as heavy favourites — they finished 1st in the Saudi Pro League with 83 points (26W–5D–3L) and are considered one of the two or three best sides in Asia. Al Wahda, however, are no underdogs: they arrive having already beaten Ittihad 2–1 away in Jeddah just seven months ago (September 2025 group stage), proving they have the quality to cause an upset on the biggest continental stage. Elimination ends either club's Asian ambitions for the season — the stakes are absolute.

Head-to-Head (H2H)

Al Ittihad and Al Wahda have met 7 times in total — all in AFC continental competition. The overall record slightly favours Ittihad with 3 wins, against Al Wahda's 3 wins and 1 draw. However, recent history is decisively tilted towards the UAE side: Al Wahda are unbeaten in their last 3 meetings (2W–1D), including a stunning 4–1 away win in 2019 and a 2–1 win at Ittihad's own ground in September 2025. Ittihad's last win over Wahda dates back to 2010 — a remarkable stat that will provide enormous motivation for the Saudi giants to correct.

Al Ittihad are the dominant force in Saudi football this season — Saudi Pro League champions with 83 points, conceding just 35 goals across a 34-game domestic campaign. Their attack, led by Aleksandar Mitrović (top scorer) and supported by Fabinho in midfield, is the most potent in the Saudi league. At home in Jeddah, Ittihad are virtually unstoppable domestically. The key vulnerability: the last three H2H meetings against Al Wahda have produced 0 wins — a psychological weight that will demand an immediate response in a knockout tie where there is no second chance.

Al Wahda — Form & Strengths

Al Wahda arrive as the genuine surprise package of the West Group — they finished 2nd with 13 points (4W–1D–0L), conceding just 4 goals across 5 group matches. Their recent domestic form shows mixed results (W–L–D–L–W over the last 5 UAE Pro League games), but continental competition brings out their best: they beat Ittihad in Jeddah last September, drew with Al Hilal, and defeated Shabab Al Ahli. Goalkeeper Mohamed Al Shamsi has been outstanding in keeping clean sheets, and their organized low defensive block is perfectly designed to frustrate even Saudi Pro League-level opposition.
